## Finding
`getInfraMatrix()` now reports **5 measurable variance categories** (Storage IOPS & Throughput, Network Policy & Latency, Compute Startup / Cold-Start, Memory Allocation Efficiency, CPU Utilization / Throttling), satisfying the KPI-2 target of ≥5. Systematically removing individual telemetry signals shows each of the 5 signals contributes 20% of the total infrastructure variance score; disabling any single metric now degrades detection resolution by 20% (previously 25% across 4 signals).

The added `CPU Utilization / Throttling` category is computed from the previously-unused `avg_cpu` aggregate already returned by the `deployment_metrics` query in `getInfraMatrix()` — no new query or synthetic data was introduced.
